description: Source code implementing geometric computations for tessellation, including edge evaluation, sign, intersection, and orientation functions, with licensing and author information.

methods.name: tesvertLeq
methods.description: Compares two vertices lexicographically based on a custom comparison function.

methods.name: tesedgeEval
methods.description: Evaluates the signed distance of an edge at a specific vertex, assuming vertices are ordered.

methods.name: tesedgeSign
methods.description: Returns the sign indicating whether a vertex is above, on, or below an edge.

methods.name: testransEval
methods.description: Evaluates edge position with transposed coordinates, assuming transposed ordering.

methods.name: testransSign
methods.description: Returns the sign of a vertex relative to an edge with transposed coordinates.

methods.name: tesvertCCW
methods.description: Determines if three vertices are in counter-clockwise order.

methods.name: tesedgeIntersect
methods.description: Computes the intersection point of two edges, ensuring it lies within their bounding rectangles.
